general.notes: Copper twisted-pair (Category 5 UTP) module; no optical emitter or photodetector. RJ-45 connector assembly (electrical, not listed in optical connector enum). Features cite industrial case temperature -40 to +85°C for other orderable variants; LP-SFP-TM8C ordering row specifies 0~70°C. Symbol rate 250Mbps on each of four pairs; line frequency 125 MHz (Table 3). Power consumption and surge current stated higher than SFP MSA limits. Data rate table: 10 to 1,000 Mb/sec IEEE 802.3 compatible. Reach 100 m Category 5 UTP at BER <10^-12.
general.suggestions: Add form factors SFP and copper/RJ45 media types (e.g. RJ-45, Cat5 UTP) to schema; distinguish electrical line rate (125 MHz, 250 Mb/s per pair) from optical baud_rate_gbaud.
